sources.title: The Block — Zama token sale via CoinList and its own auction app (13 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 13 Jan 2026. 11B ZAMA total supply; 12% sold: 2% community sale to OG NFT holders, 8% sealed-bid Dutch auction on Ethereum 21–24 Jan (CoinList as distribution partner), 2% post-auction sale at clearing price 27 Jan–2 Feb. Floor $0.005 ($55M FDV), no upper bound. Claiming 2 Feb 2026; sale tokens fully unlocked. Zama has raised >$150M (Multicoin, Pantera, Protocol Labs); last equity round valued it >$1B. Hindi calls the sale a distribution mechanism, not a capital raise.

sources.title: Zama blog — The Zama Public Auction: $118M committed for the first encrypted ICO on Ethereum (26 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 26 Jan 2026. $118.5M committed (incl. $2.2M via KuCoin, $4.2M via CoinList); 11,103 unique bidders, 24,697 bids; clearing price $0.05; winning bids paid $44.0M; 2,805,849,657 tokens demanded vs 880,000,000 sold; 218% oversubscribed; refund ratio 62.89%. Tokens fully unlocked; claiming opens 2 Feb.

sources.title: Decrypt (Chainwire press release) — Zama's public auction attracts $118M (27 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Chainwire release, Paris dateline, 27 Jan 2026. Repeats auction figures ($118.5M committed, $121.3M total value shielded in the auction app, clearing $0.05, 880M sold, 218% oversubscribed). States the protocol had no downtime during the auction. Mainnet launched with the first confidential USDT transfer on Ethereum.

sources.title: Bitget research — In-depth analysis and market cap of Zama (ZAMA) (30 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 30 Jan 2026. Total supply 11B. Allocation: public auction 8%, community sale 2%, pre-TGE sale 2% (all unlocked at TGE 2 Feb 2026); Treasury 20% (part at TGE, rest vests, fully unlocked by month 48–50); Team 20% (12-month cliff then linear, fully unlocked by month 48–50); VCs 20% and Angels 10% (12-month cliff then linear, largely unlocked by month 24); Growth 10% (part at TGE, linear to month 48); TGE campaigns 6%; liquidity 2% mentioned separately. TGE circulating ~2.25B (~20%). Funding $130M: Series A $73M (7 Mar 2024, Multicoin & Protocol Labs), Series B $57M (25 Jun 2025, Blockchange & Pantera, >$1B post-money). Auction clearing $0.05 implies ~$550M FDV. Founders: Rand Hindi (CEO, founded Snips, acquired), Pascal Paillier (CTO, co-inventor of the Paillier scheme). FHE peer Mind Network FDV ~$125M. Partners named: OpenZeppelin, Conduit. No exploit or incident mentioned.

sources.title: Zama blog — Announcing the Zama Public Auction (1 Dec 2025)
sources.excerpt: Published 1 Dec 2025. Floor $55M FDV 'based on a total supply of 11B tokens'. Sale split 2% OG-NFT holders at floor (40,000 tokens per NFT), 8% sealed-bid Dutch auction, 2% post-auction at clearing price ($10k cap). All protocol fees are burned; operator and staker rewards are minted on a yearly emission schedule. Utility: pay for encryption/decryption, stake/delegate to operators.

sources.title: Zama blog — Stake $ZAMA (2 Feb 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 2 Feb 2026. Delegated proof-of-stake; inflation starts at 5% of total ZAMA supply per year. 18 active operators: 13 KMS nodes and 5 FHE coprocessors; new operators must stake ≥0.5% of circulating ZAMA; epochs ~3 months. 60% of rewards to KMS operators/delegators, 40% to coprocessors; rewards scale with sqrt(stake); commission capped 20%; 7-day unbonding. Protocol updates require majority operator approval, managed through Aragon. No slashing described.

sources.excerpt: Published 2 Feb 2026. Claims open 12:00 UTC, trading on major exchanges 13:00 UTC. Contracts: Ethereum 0xa12cc123ba206d4031d1c7f6223d1c2ec249f4f3, BSC 0x6907a5986c4950bdaf2f81828ec0737ce787519f, Solana 4Zp52aF4hZi9fzH19xpbWKYKQvgLyCN67KFbrQDqeTKh. 'All fees are burned, while rewards are minted according to a yearly emission schedule.' Bridge at bridge.zama.org; staking at staking.zama.org.

sources.title: MEXC News — Zama pre-TGE campaign on Binance Wallet (c. 29 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Undated; describes the Binance Wallet campaign starting 29 Jan 2026 and the 2 Feb distribution as upcoming. sources.title: KuCoin — Introducing Zama (ZAMA) on KuCoin Spotlight (19 Jan 2026)
sources.excerpt: Published 19 Jan 2026. Total supply 11,000,000,000 ZAMA; 880,000,000 offered in the sealed-bid Dutch auction 21–24 Jan; price range $0.005–$5.00. Excluded jurisdictions include US, UK, Canada, France, Netherlands, Singapore. Series B $57M (Blockchange, Pantera); total funding >$150M; valuation >$1B. No audits mentioned.

total_supply.note: also ZAMA-08, ZAMA-16; genesis supply. Not a hard cap: ZamaERC20 has an uncapped mint (ZAMA-18) used for staking emissions

circulating_supply.note: TGE circulating; ZAMA-08 gives 2.25B, ZAMA-11/ZAMA-13 round to 2.2B

market_cap_usd.note: 2.25B circulating × $0.05 auction clearing price, the last price set before listing. No exchange price existed on the morning of 2 Feb; a pre-market contract traded near $0.043 on 29 Jan (ZAMA-12)

insider_allocation_pct.note: Team 20% + VCs 20% + Angels 10%. Treasury (20%) and Growth (10%) are Zama-controlled but not counted; with them, Zama and its investors control 80% of genesis supply

team_vesting_months.note: 12-month cliff, then linear; fully unlocked by month 48–50

unlock_12m_pct_of_circ.note: ESTIMATE. Team/VC/Angel cliffs end at month 12, so their unlocks begin just outside the window. Inside it: Treasury remainder (~2.2B less its TGE part) and Growth (~1.1B) vesting linearly to ~month 48 → ~0.825B over 12 months ÷ 2.25B circulating. Exact TGE portions and monthly amounts were not published in a pre-listing source I could read; if Treasury vests over 24 months the figure rises to ~61%. Excludes the 5% staking emission (see annual_inflation_pct). Then ~5.5B of insider tokens (2.4× TGE float) start unlocking from Feb 2027

unlock_90d_pct_of_circ.note: ESTIMATE: one quarter of the 12-month Treasury + Growth figure (~0.206B ÷ 2.25B). No insider cliff falls in the first 90 days

annual_inflation_pct.note: Emission is 5% of TOTAL supply per year = ~550M ZAMA/yr; as a share of the 2.25B TGE float that is 24.4%. Fee burns offset an unknown, likely small, amount at launch. Governance can change the rate (ZAMA-13)

price_to_last_round_multiple.note: Investors bought equity (Series A $73M, Series B $57M at >$1B post-money), not a priced token round; no per-token cost basis is public. For scale: the $550M auction FDV is ~0.55× the last equity valuation
